All 5 admin tabs now switch repeatedly with zero JS errors.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `useEffect(load, [])` where load returned a Promise made React use the Promise as the cleanup function -> runtime crash 'destroy is not a function' and full ErrorBoundary screen ('Algo se ha torcido') as soon as the user left the Bloqueos tab (e.g. Bloqueos -> Clientes). Wrapped in `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` and added Array.isArray guard + toast catch. Please keep this pattern (never pass an async/promise-returning fn directly to useEffect).

issues: Bento grid layout collapses: container is h-[500px] with grid-rows-3 but item layout needs 4 rows on mobile (col-span-2 row-span-2 + col-span-2 + 2 x col-span-1), so an implicit 4th row appears. Measured rows: 34.8px/34.8px/34.8px/359.6px -> gallery-item-0 renders 350x82 and gallery-item-1 350x35 (thin cropped slivers) while gallery-item-2/3 render 169x360. Images are not stretched (object-cover) but the featured photos are practically invisible on mobile. Suggest a mobile-specific grid (e.g. grid-cols-2 auto-rows-[160px] with row-span only from md:).
Uses native browser date picker (<input type="date"> at data-testid=blk-date) instead of the shadcn Calendar used in the public booking flow - inconsistent look with the graphite+gold theme.
Sundays (closed day per working-hours weekday 6) are selectable; selecting them just yields 'no-slots'. Minor UX: disable closed weekdays in the calendar.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin panel crash RCA: BlockersPanel had `const load = () => api.get('/blockers').then(...)` (implicit arrow return = Promise) passed directly as the effect callback: `useEffect(load, [])`. React stores the return value as the destructor and calls it on unmount -> 'destroy is not a function' -> ErrorBoundary. Reproduced by logging in and clicking Bloqueos then Clientes. Fixed by wrapping the call in a void arrow function; verified by 7 consecutive tab switches with 0 JS errors.
